entries.title: Psalms 99:1
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: People - Such as are enemies to God and his people. Sitteth - Upon the ark. He is present with his people. Earth - The people of the earth. Moved - With fear and trembling.

entries.title: Psalms 99:4
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: Judgment - Though his dominion be absolute, and his power irresistible, yet he manages it with righteousness. The king's strength is by a known Hebraism put for the strong, or powerful king. Equity - In all thy proceedings.

entries.title: Psalms 99:5
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: Foot - stool - Before the ark, which is so called, 1Chron 28:2. Holy - It is consecrated to be a pledge of God's presence.

entries.title: Psalms 99:6
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: Moses - Moses before the institution of the priesthood executed that office, Exod 24:6. That call - Who used frequently and solemnly to intercede with God on the behalf of the people.

entries.title: Psalms 99:7
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: Spake - To some of them: to Moses and Aaron, Exod 19:24 33:9 - 11 1Sam 7:9, &c.

entries.title: Psalms 99:8
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: Them - The intercessors before mentioned. Forgavest - The people for whom they prayed, so far as not to inflict that total destruction upon them which they deserved;
